WITH monthly_sales AS (

),
with_previous AS (

    FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS months_with_increase

WHERE previous_total_units IS NOT NULL

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', day)::date AS month,
        SUM(units) AS total_units
    FROM sales_daily
    GROUP BY 1
),
month_range AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        (SELECT MIN(month) FROM monthly_sales),
        (SELECT MAX(month) FROM monthly_sales),
        INTERVAL '1 month'
    )::date AS month
),
with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        mr.month,
        COALESCE(ms.total_units, 0) AS total_units
    FROM month_range mr
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms USING (month)
),
with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        total_units,
        LAG(total_units) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_units
    FROM with_totals
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS months_higher_than_previous
FROM with_previous
WHERE previous_units IS NOT NULL
  AND total_units > previous_units
